name: MH3 Vita
author: Grarak
description: A static recompilation of Monster Hunter Tri (Wii) to native ARM code. The game's PowerPC code is translated to C++ and linked with a native runtime that replaces the Wii's hardware and system software: there is no emulator, interpreter or JIT. Rendering goes through native GXM on the PS Vita and OpenGL ES 3.0 on Linux; a WebAssembly build draws through WebGPU.
requirements:
- kubridge.skprx
- CapUnlocker.skprx
- Game Data Files: Wii
